description:
Hello! We are a team passionate about technology, innovation, and space exploration. After participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we are excited to develop new ideas in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Analysis, and Programming.

We are looking for curious, creative, and motivated teammates who enjoy problem-solving, teamwork, and learning new technologies. Experience in Python, AI, or space-related research is a plus, but enthusiasm and a willingness to learn matter most.
